query: What does 'good faith' mean under BNS?

required_points: Under Section 2(11), nothing is said to be done or believed in good faith which is done or believed without due care and attention.
Good faith requires due care and attention; it is not merely an honest but careless belief.
optional_points: The good faith standard is relevant in many general exceptions, such as Sections 26, 27, 30, 31.
forbidden_points: Good faith means any honest belief, even without any care or attention.
Good faith requires a legal qualification or expertise.

notes: Definition query. Section 2(11). Note the due care and attention requirement.
